records.critical_edition: Hochstetter et al., Herrn von Leibniz' Rechnung mit Null und Eins (1966); Akademie-Ausgabe editions. (Not published in Gerhardt Math. Schr.; public-domain binary paper is 1703 Explication de l'Arithmétique Binaire). Needs bibliographic verification.
records.notes: The 1679 manuscript LH XXXV, 3, 2 was first published in the 20th century (Hochstetter et al., 1966 / Akademie-Ausgabe) and is not in Gerhardt's Math. Schr. Status remains source-identified-transcription-needed pending acquisition of non-copyrighted witness or manual transcription.
